Cloud.//Endpoint: Your loveheartbeat API base. The /api/v1/collectors/* paths are appended.
Cloud.//EnrollmentToken: One-time, from 'Add collector' in the dashboard. Used once, then never again. Prefer CONTOSO_COLLECTOR_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN.
Cloud.//CollectorCredential: Only for out-of-band provisioning; normally null and issued by enrollment.
Cloud.//EnvToken: Required by app.loveheartbeat.com, which fronts dev/qa/prod. Copy window.__ENV_TOKEN__ from the site's /assets/js/runtime-config.js. Leave null against a backend directly. Env var: CONTOSO_COLLECTOR_ENV_TOKEN.

Ingress.//ProbeKey: Shared secret every probe presents as X-Probe-Key. Prefer CONTOSO_PROBE_KEY.

//Kestrel: Binds to the LAN so probes and apps can reach the collector. Never expose it to the internet. Note: Kestrel parses every key under Endpoints as an endpoint, so no comment keys are allowed in there.
